component.name: Lerd
component.summary: A dedicated window for the lerd dashboard

description.p: Lerd wraps the lerd local PHP development dashboard in a dedicated desktop window. It connects to the lerd services running on your machine and shows native desktop notifications for captured mail, worker failures, and finished operations, with no browser tab to keep open.

This app is a companion to lerd and needs lerd installed on the host. lerd runs Nginx, PHP-FPM and your databases as rootless Podman containers, and serves its dashboard on your own machine. The app talks only to that local dashboard.

ul.li: See your sites, services and queue workers at a glance
Switch PHP and Node versions per site and start or stop workers
Read request timing, slow routes, logs and captured mail
Open the main tabs straight from the taskbar

screenshot.caption: The dashboard with sites, services, workers and system health
A site with its workers, services and request timing

description.p: When Lerd isn't installed, the start screen's button copies the install command to paste into a terminal. Lerd Desktop is also available for macOS as a DMG for Apple silicon and Intel, where the same button runs the installer in Terminal.
Install-Lerd.exe trusts Lerd's certificate in Windows again, and its uninstaller takes it back, now that Lerd no longer ships mkcert.
Install-Lerd.exe connects Lerd with Windows again on a fresh machine, by running the install script from the lerd release it installs.

Runs on Windows for lerd under WSL, holding lerd's tray menu, notifications and lerd:// links there, and ships Install-Lerd.exe, a wizard that sets up WSL, Ubuntu, lerd and this app on a machine with nothing installed.
The app reports its real version again.
Brings back your dashboard settings, theme and notifications after the move to Electron 44, and draws the header in the same tone as the window's title bar again.
Runs on Electron 44 and the 26.08 runtime.
The store listing gains screenshots, release notes and links to the source and issue tracker.
Remembers the window size and position between launches, and can be switched to X11 through ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT.
Taskbar quick actions open the main tabs directly.
